title: dev-copilot: stale docs after the rename
cluster_summary: Phase 2 of the wow-addon -> dev-copilot rename finished on 2026-10-04, but several docs were not updated with it. The audit-rotation frontmatter descriptions (agents/ and commands/wow-standards-audit.md) and README.md:73 still name the archived wow-addon as a documentation-lane repo. CLAUDE.md:110 still allowlists mentions that af92781 removed. The profile lists in README:5/:51 and in both manifests leave out the tooling kind. DEPENDENCIES.md carries hard counts and line citations that have drifted. All fixes belong in dev-copilot as two docs-only commits. The first is a rename sweep that merges DC-A-07, DC-R-10 and DC-R-15 and keeps the two manifest descriptions byte-identical. The second is DEPENDENCIES.md, merging DC-A-08 and DC-R-09: describe the inventory by its git ls-files command rather than by counts, and re-cite against the final tree after this run's docs/audits and docs/reviews bundles land. The baseline table (DC-R-11) is reviewer-only and goes stale by design, so it stays optional.

verdicts.assessment: Verified on the branch. Both wow-standards-audit frontmatter descriptions name wow-addon in the documentation lane; this text is shown in the skill listing and contradicts the agent body. README.md:73 does the same. CLAUDE.md:110 allowlists removed items and contradicts :82 and :152. CLAUDE.md:91 says 'both symlinks' where only one remains. The fix is a cheap docs sweep that resolves a real self-contradiction.
verdicts.remediation: One sweep commit, merged with DC-R-10 and DC-R-15. Change wow-addon to dev-copilot in agents/wow-standards-audit.md:3, commands/wow-standards-audit.md:2 and README.md:73. Trim the CLAUDE.md:110 allowlist to the mentions that still exist (the README migration note, frozen bundles) and drop 'unchanged until phase 2'. In CLAUDE.md:91, change 'both symlinks' to 'the runner symlink'. Add the tooling kind to the kind list in README.md:5 (keep the retired-plugin link) and README.md:51, and to the plugins[0].description of plugin.json and marketplace.json, keeping the two byte-identical. The top-level marketplace description needs no change. No version bump is required: CLAUDE.md:107 asks for one only when a command is added or removed.

verdicts.assessment: The CLAUDE.md:110 and README.md:73 defects are real and duplicate DC-A-07. The 'legacy wow-addon' clause in the issue-details and issue-summary overlays is not wrong. It applies only while the repo still holds issues, and the archived repo has 0 open, so dropping it is optional tidying.
verdicts.remediation: Handle in the DC-A-07 sweep: the CLAUDE.md:110 rewrite and the README.md:73 rename. You may also drop the wow-addon clause from profiles/wow/issue-details.md:9 and issue-summary.md:9, and remove wow-addon from the issue-summary scan list in the same edit. This deliberately drops the archived repo's closed issues from the done/all views.

verdicts.assessment: README.md:14 defines the tooling kind, but README.md:5 and :51 and both manifest descriptions leave it out. The lists are incomplete, not wrong, and no behavior changes. It costs almost nothing because the same lines are edited for DC-A-07.
verdicts.remediation: Fold into the DC-A-07 sweep. Add 'tooling repos' to README.md:5 and :51 and to both plugins[0].description strings, kept byte-identical. Do not open a separate item.

verdicts.assessment: Confirmed. DEPENDENCIES.md:12-13 states 61/43/3, but git ls-files gives 62/44/4. The hook citation :33 points past the end of a 31-line file. finalize.md:28-29 is a blank line plus a heading, and the gate commands are at :32-33. wow-revendor-libka0s.md:316 is a fence and the command is at :317. The python3/git/perl/coreutils floors give no reason, a documentation-§7 MUST gap, though the bash floor does give one. CLAUDE.md:38 leaves out the phase-2 plan. This is a MUST-tagged doc defect with an out-of-range citation, so it should be fixed, but cheaply.
verdicts.remediation: One commit, merged with DC-R-09, made after this run's docs/audits and docs/reviews bundles land in dev-copilot. Replace the fixed inventory counts with the git ls-files commands and describe docs/ without a count. Re-cite to scripts/bounded-runs-hook.sh:30, profiles/wow/finalize.md:32-33 and commands/wow-revendor-libka0s.md:317, checked against the final tree. Annotate the python3/git/perl/coreutils floors with a reason or 'any recent', without researching true minimums. Add docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-04-phase2-rename-ripple.md to the CLAUDE.md:38 docs/ inventory.

verdicts.assessment: Duplicates the inventory and citation half of DC-A-08, and its line refs are the precise ones: :30, :32-33 and :317. Its command-based inventory approach is the fix that stops the drift from recurring.
verdicts.remediation: Fix in the DC-A-08 commit: a command-based inventory with no fixed docs/ count, plus the three re-citations made against the post-bundle tree. Do not open a separate item.

verdicts.assessment: The agent-review.md:421-457 baseline was recorded against v1.56.0, and LibKa0s is now at v1.70.0. The brief already treats a moved tag as a 'stale brief, not a finding' and says to re-derive, so no reviewer is misled; only the diff shortcut is lost. Re-measuring now just resets a clock that the release cadence will run out again within days. Only reviewers see it.
verdicts.remediation: Optional. Do not re-measure for the sake of it. If the table is touched, the durable fix is to keep the commands and drop the frozen 'Recorded' figures and the v1.56.0 mentions at :421, :429, :432, :448 and :456, with an instruction to measure at review time.
